appearanceEvidence.policy: Use robust grouped median color only; do not copy raw shadows, exposure differences or seams into the clean model.

wallPatternEligibility.rule: Allow a repeated glazing pattern only on non-parapet walls at least 4.5 m wide and no more than 2.25 m inside the level-wise convex hull; use solid evidence color on suppressed walls.

effectiveWallPatternEligibility.rule: Geometric eligibility is the default. A held-out-validated registered photo covering at least 25% and 100 m² of the same WallSurface overrides geometric suppression only for that polygon.

sameSurfaceExtensions.basis: held-out-validated registered photo visibly covers at least 25% of this same WallSurface; extend its facade pattern only within this polygon

warnings: Camera is fitted to manually read controls and passed held-out structural-edge validation (6 edges, median 14.5px, p90 31.5px); this is not survey-grade calibration.

Direct registered ground-photo evidence covers 21.0% of wall area. PLATEAU appearance directly supports 161 polygons and same-object transfer supports 19; 180/181 base polygons have image-derived color evidence.

1 geometrically suppressed wall was overridden by held-out-validated evidence on that same polygon; 1121.4 m² outside the directly visible patch is filled with a separately labeled same-surface extension.

The widened Commons search produced 591 candidates; two license-compatible exact-building images were acquired. One is geometrically registered and one independently validates the palette (ΔE76 9.7). KartaView produced 1102 candidates, but all 15 audited frames were excluded: The search was expanded to a 0.005-degree padded area with 1102 candidates. The nearest heading-compatible added frames were audited: two are night/expressway views and one is a daytime local streetscape where the target facade is absent or too small. Existing nearest frames remain dark or occluded, so none supports stable target albedo.

Window bands are deterministic image-pattern hypotheses applied to 7 facades: 6 pass the geometric rule and 1 additional same-WallSurface case passes the direct-evidence override. Remaining recessed, service, parapet and short walls stay suppressed; CityGML contains zero Window/Door opening polygons.

The two outer BuildingInstallation groups are explicit CityGML objects. Their exact equipment functions remain unresolved, so rendering preserves measured luminance while reducing chroma toward unobtrusive industrial neutral.
Original image and PLATEAU geometry are unchanged.
